regime_context: The detector shows a two-theme leadership structure: AI Infrastructure narrowly leads US Energy Complex (margin 0.185, not one-narrative), with rotation breadth narrowing (0.45 eligible, absorption 0.31, directional=false). The absolute-trend gate is the only validated edge and it is active (gate_helps true); rank-IC is ~0, so momentum is a focus lens, not a return forecast. Backtest verdict: discipline_not_prediction. Track record shows 66% hit rate but only 48% directional accuracy — treat high-conviction calls with humility.
emerging_watch: Watching Managed Care & Insurers (rank 28): it has the highest durability_bar in the entire board (0.81), high breadth (0.778), a clean trend tag, and is eligible despite a negative score — its rank is near the bottom but its staying-power and participation are remarkably strong. The condition that would retire this watch is either (a) its score turns positive and it breaks into the top 15 while staying eligible, which would confirm a leadership handoff forming, or (b) its durability_bar falls below 0.5, which would mean the trend cohesion is failing.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infrastructure is the rank-1 leader (score 1.56), passing the absolute-trend eligibility gate (eligible=true), which is the detector's one validated leg (drawdown/shake-out avoidance). Durability_bar sits just at 0.5 (the threshold) but breadth is very low (0.125) and hurst_tag is mixed — leadership is concentrated, not confirmed by broad participation. The lean is a directional expression that the trend-gate stays intact, NOT a forecast that the rank persists.
theses.dissent: Low breadth (0.125) means the theme is carried by a handful of names; a single high-weight name rolling over could drag the whole proxy (SMH) while the ranking still shows leadership. The mixed hurst tag suggests the trend is not self-reinforcing.

falsifier.text: SMH trades below its own 50-day average while remaining above the trend-gate eligibility line for 10 consecutive sessions before the check-by date

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: US Energy Complex is rank-2 (score 1.375), eligible, with notably better breadth (0.636) and durability (0.62) than the leader — a cleaner, more broadly-participated trend that also passes the absolute-trend gate. Crowding is not flagged (z=0.93 < threshold). The lean is supported by trend-gate eligibility plus higher breadth than the rank-1 theme.
theses.dissent: Mixed hurst tag and crowding_z near 0.93 (close to the crowded flag) suggest the theme may be late-cycle; energy is highly sensitive to a macro/policy regime shift that is not captured by the coincident detector.

falsifier.text: XLE breaks below its absolute-trend eligibility line (theme.eligible flips false) for 5 consecutive sessions before the check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is rank-3, eligible, with the strongest trend tag in the top tier (hurst_tag=trend, distinct from the mixed leaders) and durability_bar=0.75, the highest among the top ranks. However crowding_z=1.61 marks it crowded=true — per guardrails this is a SIZE-DOWN caution only, never a fade or short. The lean is a modest overweight on trend-gate eligibility plus strong trend health, tempered by crowding.
evidence: hurst_tag=trend (cleanest trend signal in top ranks)
theses.dissent: The crowded flag (z=1.61) means positioning is stretched; reflexivity cuts both ways and a shake-out would hit this theme harder than non-crowded peers. Breadth is mid (0.6), so the theme is broad but not exceptional.

falsifier.text: CIBR gives up half of its 20-day advance while remaining above the trend-gate line before the check-by date
